home.eyebrow: Business Analyst · Ho Chi Minh City
home.title: I turn messy processes into systems people can build.
home.lead: I'm Gyn Nguyen, a Business Analyst with an engineering background. I map processes in BPMN, break systems into parts, write the requirements and model the data. On the side, I build and ship my own apps and games.
home.approachTitle: From a process to a system
home.approachLead: Start with how the work actually flows, then decide where each step lives: interface, API, services or data. That stretch between a stakeholder's idea and a developer's ticket is where I'm most useful.

how.title: BPMN process modelling
how.text: As-Is and To-Be flows in BPMN 2.0, including the gateways and exceptions people forget to mention.

how.title: System decomposition
how.text: Breaking a product into modules, interfaces and integrations before anyone estimates it.

how.title: Requirements
how.text: BRD and PRD, user stories with Gherkin acceptance criteria, agreed with stakeholders before the sprint starts.

how.title: Data modelling
how.text: ERDs normalised to 3NF, SQL for analysis and reporting, API contracts the team can build against.

how.title: Delivery and UAT
how.text: Backlog refinement, UAT plans and sign-off, so what ships matches what was agreed.

how.title: Building it myself
how.text: Over four years of .NET and SQL, plus the projects below. I can judge feasibility early because I write the code too.

relighthost.description: A real-time audio plugin host for Windows. Chain VST3, VST2 and CLAP plugins, route a live mic through them over ASIO or WASAPI, and clean up your voice with built-in AI noise suppression.
points: Hosts VST3, VST2 and CLAP natively, editors open in real native windows
A plugin that keeps crashing is reloaded in an isolated child process
Devices, chain and plugin state come back exactly as you left them
relighthost.alt: ReLightHost main window with a signal chain and two plugin editors open

anivor.description: A survivors-style roguelite in cute pixel art. Pick a hero, outlast swarms and bosses, build your weapons each level-up. Runs entirely in the browser, no game engine.
points: 12 heroes, boss waves, weapon evolutions and chests
Name + PIN accounts that sync progress across devices
anivor.alt: Animal Survivor gameplay: a dragon hero fighting the Spore Mushroom King boss among a swarm

gfgames.description: Retro fighting games in the browser: arcade, Neo-Geo, PlayStation and Flash. Every game gets its own room, so you share a link and players 2 to 4 join from their own device.
points: Rooms per game with P2–P4 invite links over LAN
Gamepads detected automatically, keys fully remappable
gfgames.alt: GFGames lobby: the hero above the list of fighting games

gpm.description: Weekly task boards, project docs and client-ready weekly reports for teams running many projects at once. Paste a long report and AI turns it into task updates.
points: Workspaces per team, clients, PICs and member roles
Weekly reports clients open without an account
Claude reads progress and updates tasks over MCP

viethoa.description: A ruleset that teaches an AI to localise games into Vietnamese. Hand it the game's text files and the developer's description: it analyses the game into a Game Bible, then translates, edits and checks its own work.
points: An 8-step workflow with a review stop: Game Bible, pronoun matrix and glossary are approved before bulk translation
Rules per string type (UI, dialogue, choices, items, quests, lore) and for removing translationese
A Python validator with no dependencies: placeholders and tags for Unity, Unreal, RPG Maker, Ren'Py and Godot, glossary, NFC and length

steps: Analyse the game into a Game Bible
Translate by scene and string type
mock.stop: Review stop: approved before bulk translation

vbook.description: A personal extension pack for VBook, a reader app for comics and novels. Each source is a small plugin: a plugin.json plus scripts for the home feed, search, details, chapter list and chapter content.
points: Source plugins for comics, novels and video
Text-to-speech plugins (Google, Gemini, Bing and more) for listening to novels
Comic, novel and video templates, plus a tutorial for writing new plugins

about.name: Gyn Nguyen
about.professionalIntroContent: A dedicated Business Analyst with a strong engineering foundation in C#, .NET, and SQL databases. Specializing in translating complex stakeholder visions into airtight business requirements (BRD/PRD), optimizing end-to-end workflows (BPMN 2.0), and collaborating seamlessly with cross-functional development squads to deliver high-impact enterprise solutions.
about.visionContent_1: Requirements Engineering & Business Process Optimization: Experienced in eliciting, structuring, and validating business requirements from diverse stakeholders. Proficient in crafting comprehensive Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Product Requirements Documents (PRD), User Stories with Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin/BDD), and modeling clear As-Is / To-Be business processes using BPMN 2.0.
about.visionContent_2: Technical Foundation & Data Modeling (The Competitive Edge): Leveraged over 4 years of software development (.NET, SQL Server, MySQL, RESTful APIs) to evaluate technical feasibility early, design normalized entity-relationship schemas (ERD), write analytical SQL queries (PIVOT, Stored Procedures), and define unambiguous API contracts with engineering squads.
about.visionContent_3: Long-term Objectives: Drive digital transformation by championing agile methodologies, reducing delivery risks, eliminating requirements churn, and architecting robust digital solutions that maximize operational efficiency and enterprise value.

tetris.title: Tetris Lab
tetris.subtitle: No login, no ranking. Just stack, spin and clear.
tetris.zenDesc: Endless mode. Gravity speeds up every 10 lines; topping out just clears the board.

lesson.tss: Rotate the T under the overhang so it hooks into the slot. Only one line clears.
lesson.tsd: Rotate CW, soft drop to the bottom, then rotate CW again so the T hooks under the overhang. The last move must be a rotation.
lesson.tst: Slide the T under the roof on the left, then rotate CW — the kick drops it 2 rows into the triple slot.
lesson.mini: Rest the T flat in the bottom-left corner, then rotate CW into the wall for a T-Spin Mini.
lesson.quad: Hold the O (C) and take the I first — drop it into the well for a Quad.
lesson.pc: Fill the gaps with L and J so the board is completely empty.

tetris.garbageDesc: A bot sends gray garbage. Incoming lines wait in the bar right of the board (red = ready). Clear lines to cancel them — otherwise they rise from the bottom when you place a piece without clearing. Single 0 · Double 1 · Triple 2 · Quad 4 · TSD 4 · TST 6 · B2B +1 · combo boosts attack.
tetris.bossDesc: Drain the boss's HP with attack. Your attack cancels incoming garbage first — only the leftover hits the boss. Top out and you lose.
